blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A defense witness testified in court that the more than P64,000 in compensation Vice President Sara Duterte received from the Davao City government in 2023 represented a salary differential for the time when she served as mayor in 2020 to 2021. She clarified that the fund was not payment for another service or practice of profession. City Accountant Vinjelin Bajan of Davao City made these statements on Tuesday as she took the witness stand on the 41st day of Duterte’s impeachment trial. Her appearance comes as the defense sought to counter the prosecution’s allegation that the vice president […]...
